content_selection: Among core FIT candidates passing the predeclared FIT image gate, minimize J; practical ties <0.001 keep the earlier registered checkpoint because deployment graph/model count is equal.
no_content_reference: Independently minimize core J across the same three registered checkpoints, with the same practical tie order; never choose a weak control based on content results.
required_increment: Selected content J strictly lower than selected no-content J; at least one normalized core primary strictly lower.
guard_rule: Freeze primary checkpoint on core before running five guards; a guard failure does not trigger checkpoint reselection.
seed2_gate: Primary downstream image gate and content increment, then same selection rule for verification only; cannot replace primary seed.
